text:
sofia: 🎉 Hey team — quick shout: hosted API just crossed 1,000,000 monthly requests! absolutely wild. thank you everyone :tada:
miles: OMG YES!!! :sparkles: this is what happens when you ship reliable stuff :rocket:
raj: Massive props to batching + smart routing. made the difference on cost + latency :heart_eyes:
ellie: Pizza party? cake? gif montage? we deserve something fun :pizza::cake::confetti_ball:
sam: Pizza for sure. and maybe a small cake for the engineers who stayed late last week :coffee:
lena: Virtual champagne for folks remote? :champagne: Also, can we get dairy-free options?
dev-bot: Deploybot: Canary rollout completed to 2 nodes, no errors, 0.0% failure rate in last 30m. Congrats!
sofia: quick poll — reply with an emoji: :pizza: pizza / :cake: cake / :doughnut: donuts / :coffee: coffee
miles: :pizza:
raj: :cake: (but pizza is good too)
ellie: :coffee: (i need the caffeine)
sam: :pizza: :+1:
lena: :doughnut:
sofia: tally: pizza wins by a hair. ordering now. dietary notes? @raj @lena
raj: gluten-free is fine for me
lena: dairy-free please if possible, thanks!
sofia: noted — ordering GF & dairy-free slices. big shoutout to infra & runtime teams for stabilizing peak traffic
miles: shoutout to @runtime-team and @ingest for those optimizations :raised_hands:
ellie: i'll grab balloons and a tiny cake for the office tomorrow at 3pm 
sam: remote hangout? can we do a 10-min Zoom toast for folks offsite?
lena: yes please, i can join from EU after 10am my time
sofia: love it. zoom link posted in #random shortly. also pinned the dashboard screenshot to the channel :camera_flash: (link)
miles: can we print a small sticker: "1M requests — Redwood Inference"? asking for a friend :sticker:
sofia: noted. maybe merch team can do one-off stickers. thanks again all — so proud of this team :heart:
